FAQs About Movies Showing Now in Malaysia

The list refreshes as new films open and current titles finish their run, so it always reflects what's screening across the GSC cinemas in Malaysia.

You can check movie showtimes in Malaysia on the GSC website by selecting either “Showtimes by Cinema” or “Showtimes by Movie”. Then choose your preferred date, hall format, and session time, and proceed to buy tickets online.

Movies are typically screened for at least 2 weeks, depending on audience demand.

Check the official age classification and movie synopsis before purchasing tickets.

Clicking on a movie title usually provides additional information such as synopsis, trailer, runtime, classification, language, and available showtimes, helping viewers make informed decisions.
